- Initial release of yaps-dictation skill.
- Enables voice typing on desktop using Yaps (v2.3.124+ required).
- Provides setup guidance, troubleshooting steps, and recent dictation recovery.
- Directs users to complete microphone and accessibility permissions in OS/Yaps.
- Distinguishes between capture, transcription, and insertion failures during diagnostics.
- Explicit boundaries: no remote microphone control, background recording, or unverified permissions.
